chunks: He brings the living from the dead, the dead from the living, and quickens the earth after it had died. So will you be brought forth (from the dead).
ai.seo_question: What are the three signs of Allah's power of resurrection mentioned in Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited as a foundational proof for bodily resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jismani), emphasizing that the Creator who restores life to dead earth is fully capable of reassembling human bodies. The triad of natural signs—life from death, death from life, and land revival—serves as a logical bridge to the metaphysical reality of the Hereafter, reinforcing the concept of divine omnipotence (Qudrah) in both the physical and spiritual realms.
